author: Angie Martoccio
title: One Year After Michelle Trachtenberg’s Death, Sarah Michelle Gellar Is Still Mourning
description: "You may not have been with us long enough, but we will make sure everyone remembers," Gellar said of her Buffy the Vampire Slayer co-star
content:
Sarah Michelle Gellar paid tribute to her Buffy the Vampire Slayer co-star Michelle Trachtenberg on the one-year anniversary of her death.
